scope: All11 existing people-guide rows, plus5 bounded additions; no canonical changes. Fresh web checks supplemented by expressly labelled retained/indexed evidence.

findings.issue: JDCA row conflates donor programme association with exact contents of every donated tape. Narrow to documented formats and selected digitisation.
Nirad and Aadim Vichar rows previously named documents instead of concrete work relationships. Proposed direct roles with stable citations.
Amada Bata screenplay claim remains fresh secondary-database supported, not newly verified primary credits. Retain as supported with this limitation, or omit screenplay if primary-only is absolute.

Pratikshya source is a development catalogue; certification and award records have distinct functions. Do not turn tentative dates into release dates or film awards into personal Best Director awards.

proposed_people_guide.label: Basanta Kumari Patnaik and Gopal Chhotray
proposed_people_guide.relationship: A novel and its screen adaptation
proposed_people_guide.text: Amada Bata joins Basanta Kumari Patnaik’s source novel with Gopal Chhotray’s screenplay.

proposed_people_guide.label: Kalindi Charan Panigrahi and Mrinal Sen
proposed_people_guide.text: Kalindi Charan Panigrahi receives the story credit for Matira Manisha; Mrinal Sen wrote its screenplay and directed it.

proposed_people_guide.label: Tapu Mishra and Humane Sagar
proposed_people_guide.text: Tapu Mishra and Humane Sagar are the credited voices on the Ishq Tu Hi Tu title recording.

proposed_people_guide.label: Biren Das and JD Centre of Art
proposed_people_guide.text: Biren Das donated U-matic and Beta tapes to JDCA; selected tapes were digitised with NCAA at IGNCA.

proposed_people_guide.label: Gour Prasad Ghose and Parbati Ghose
proposed_people_guide.text: Gour and Parbati produced Kaa and Stree; with Ram Chandra Thakur, they shared the directing name Siddharth.

proposed_people_guide.label: Bijay Mohanty and Parbati Ghose
proposed_people_guide.text: Bijay Mohanty plays Bhagia and Parbati Ghose plays Saria in Chha Mana Atha Guntha, adapted from Fakir Mohan Senapati’s novel.

proposed_people_guide.label: Nirad Mohapatra
proposed_people_guide.text: Nirad Mohapatra taught at FTII, organised Cinexstasy screenings and edited the film section of Mana Phasal.

proposed_people_guide.label: Roshan Bisoi and Anupam Patnaik
proposed_people_guide.text: The Pratikshya development catalogue credits Roshan Bisoi as writer and Anupam Patnaik as director and producer.

proposed_people_guide.label: Vishal Mourya and Debi Prasad Lenka
proposed_people_guide.text: Vishal Mourya and Debi Prasad Lenka co-directed DAMaN; its national award was for Best Odia Film, not Best Direction.

proposed_people_guide.label: Deependra Samal
proposed_people_guide.text: DAMaN’s certification entry names Deependra Samal alongside JP Motion Pictures.

proposed_people_guide.label: Sabyasachi Mohapatra and Kapileswar Prasad Mohapatra
proposed_people_guide.text: Aadim Vichar credits Sabyasachi Mohapatra with direction and Kapileswar Prasad Mohapatra with its story.

proposed_people_guide.label: Kanhu Charan Mohanty and Sarada Naik
proposed_people_guide.text: Kaa draws on Kanhu Charan Mohanty’s novel; its archive credits Sarada Naik with screenplay and dialogue.

proposed_people_guide.label: Prafulla Kar, Pranab Patnaik and Sikandar Alam
proposed_people_guide.text: Chha Mana Atha Guntha credits Prafulla Kar for music, with Pranab Patnaik and Sikandar Alam among its playback singers.

proposed_people_guide.label: Surya Deo and Lipika Singh Darai
proposed_people_guide.relationship: Collected traces and a film-history search
proposed_people_guide.text: IFA’s project record names Deo as Darai’s collaborator in Rediscovering Sita Bibaha, a planned work drawing on surviving records and memories.

proposed_people_guide.label: Bijaya Jena
proposed_people_guide.text: Bijaya Jena produced and directed Tara and played its title character; her production notes describe the work from those overlapping roles.

proposed_people_guide.label: Pramod Pati and Abid Surti
proposed_people_guide.text: Surti recalls developing Abid with Pati: his painted-room idea became a jointly discussed film concept, realised through frame-by-frame shooting.

claim_evidence.original_text: Amada Bata connects Patnaik’s novel with Chhotray’s screenplay.
claim_evidence.recommended_text: Amada Bata joins Basanta Kumari Patnaik’s source novel with Gopal Chhotray’s screenplay.
claim_evidence.support: Fresh direct database body and indexed full credits establish novel and screenplay. No original film credit inspection in this pass.

claim_evidence.original_text: Matira Manisha brought Panigrahi’s novel into Sen’s Odia-language film.
claim_evidence.recommended_text: Kalindi Charan Panigrahi receives the story credit for Matira Manisha; Mrinal Sen wrote its screenplay and directed it.
claim_evidence.support: Filmography directly lists Story: Kalindi Charan Panigrahi; Screenplay and Director: Mrinal Sen. Novel is known from publisher references but omitted here so the single note fully supports row.

claim_evidence.original_text: Their voices share the title song of Ishq Tu Hi Tu.
claim_evidence.recommended_text: Tapu Mishra and Humane Sagar are the credited voices on the Ishq Tu Hi Tu title recording.
claim_evidence.support: Retained official Topic/Virgin Music Group description credits both singers. Fresh direct fetch failed and exact-ID search did not return it.

claim_evidence.original_text: Das donated Ajira Orissa tapes; JDCA reports selected digitisation with NCAA at IGNCA.

claim_evidence.original_text: Their shared work includes the Siddharth directing credit with Ram Chandra Thakur.
claim_evidence.recommended_text: Gour and Parbati produced Kaa and Stree; with Ram Chandra Thakur, they shared the directing name Siddharth.
claim_evidence.support: Kaa and Stree entries list producers and expand Siddharth as three named directors. Archive dates not imported.

claim_evidence.original_text: They play Bhagia and Saria in Chha Mana Atha Guntha.

claim_evidence.support: Family memorial biography explicitly describes FTII teaching, Cinexstasy and film-section editing. No claim of readership numbers or sole influence.

claim_evidence.recommended_text: The Pratikshya development catalogue credits Roshan Bisoi as writer and Anupam Patnaik as director and producer.
claim_evidence.support: Official indexed PDF panel p122 names Roshan writer, Anupam director/producer. Direct PDF fetch exceeded tool size. Tentative April2021 completion is development metadata, not actual release date.

canonical_bindings.note_definition: [^film]: [Matira Manisha, Mrinal Sen filmography](https://www.mrinalsen.org/matira_manisha.html), 1966 credits and synopsis.
[^ishq]: [“Ishq Tu Hi Tu,” official distributed recording](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a1SSmBJw-hM), singer, composer and writer credits.
[^jdca]: JD Centre of Art, [Film Archive](https://www.jdcentreofart.org/filmarchive), Biren Das’s donation and selected digitisation.
[^adaptation]: Gour–Parbati archive, [Chha Mana Atha Guntha (1986)](https://www.gourparbati.com/movie_chha_mana_atha_guntha.php), production, screenplay, cast and technical credits.

[^bazaar]: NFDC Film Bazaar, [Viewing Room catalogue](https://filmbazaarindia.com/media/2563/viewingroom2020.pdf), printed p. 122, *Pratikshya / The Waiting*. Development-stage synopsis and tentative completion date.
[^award]: [Press Information Bureau, 70th National Film Awards for 2022](https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2045960&lang=2&reg=48), 16 August 2024, Best Odia Film entry.

[^certificate]: [Central Board of Film Certification, feature films certified in 2022](https://cbfcindia.gov.in/cbfcAdmin/assets/pdf/CC_Issued_2022.pdf), Odia table, DAMAN row 78: Deependra Samal, M/S. J P Motion Pictures, certified 21 October 2022.
[^catalogue]: Directorate of Film Festivals, [Indian Panorama 2014 catalogue](https://dff.nic.in/images/Documents/20_IPCatalogue2014.pdf), printed p. 031, *Adim Vichar* entry. Indexed catalogue text.
[^gour-parbati-kaa]: Gour–Parbati archive, [Kaa](https://www.gourparbati.com/movie_kaa.php), source novel and film credits.
[^adaptation]: Gour–Parbati archive, [Chha Mana Atha Guntha (1986)](https://www.gourparbati.com/movie_chha_mana_atha_guntha.php), production, screenplay, cast and technical credits.
[^search]: India Foundation for the Arts, [Lipika Singh Darai project record](https://indiaifa.org/grants-projects/lipika-singh-darai.html), 2024–25. Describes a search and planned work.
[^experimenta-surti]: Shai Heredia, [interview with Abid Surti](https://experimenta.in/texts/interviews/abid-surty/), Experimenta, April 2005.

source_budget_advice.rule: No quotations added; each row <=35words. Word counts here are conservative added derivation, not certification that the whole package is below each source limit. Root must aggregate with final prose/notes and existing guides.
specific_risks: Experimenta is already used substantially in Pramod profile: retain this short row only if final source-wide total remains<=200; otherwise omit this optional addition.
Bijaya filmography combines Tara production notes and film synopsis on one webpage: count both profile and row together.
GourParbati ChhaMana page supports existing cast row and proposed music row: count them together with profile/overview.
IFA project record already used in Surya and Sita profiles: this addition should replace repetitive guide summary, not trigger another prose expansion.
No added award-derived narrative from 70thNFA beyond short exact category and directing attribution.

limits: No film playback or original end-credit inspection in this task.
Direct access failures are not evidence source vanished.
Music duet and Aadim catalogue retain earlier primary-indexed support, not freshly retrieved text.
Family/creator archives support credits and participant memory; unverified promotional superlatives, financial claims and disputed dates deliberately excluded.
Selection is a navigation aid, not ranking or complete contributor history.

budget_review.method: Inspected all canonical Markdown occurrences of four source URLs. Counts below estimate source-derived prose, count relevant visible bibliography words conservatively, and add guide row. Multi-source paragraph original interpretation and facts from other sources are excluded. Not blanket exact machine allocation; no duplicate whole overview snapshot counted as a separate public chapter.
